title: OAuth token endpoint response
description: Body of a successful POST {base}/connect/token response. Standard OAuth 2.0 / OIDC shape. Note: `scope` here is a space-delimited string (unlike the array form inside the access-token JWT).

access_token.description: The access token (a JWT — see access-token-claims.schema.json).

id_token.description: Present when the openid scope was requested.

$comment: Error responses use the OAuth error shape instead: { "error": string, "error_description"?: string } with a 4xx status (e.g. access_denied, invalid_grant, invalid_client).
